scope: local consumer boundaries, not independent cross-owner acceptance

boundaries.contract: Identity integer First/Break only, not confirmation, direction or cause. Direction is owner-local. Stop delegates canonical chronology, exact-object number cache; crossing uses unchanged Decimal level and half-open lower search [max(confirmation,range_start),range_end), strict directional comparator, with result cache. No local rounding in OA21–OA24.

OA19 caches exact tuple or None; OA17 uses sorted trend-position cache including None; E sequence reset setter clears candidate/direct/carried/post-stop caches, not all other caches. E live override uses dirty-time and continuation search; run-local cache freshness, callback stability, exact lower chronology and physical input immutability remain conditional.

Registration checks S root eligibility and hard reset first, calls OA23 with parent-specific flags then separately requests OA19 and appends direct match only if absent by physical identity. No repeat OA22/decision-deadline after supplement. Thus local at-most-one parent-stop candidate does not certify accepted ledger cardinality or downstream registration; separate source review needed.

Accepted reset-leg registration separately invalidates carried caches and writes physical audit ledger/confirmation index; OA23 temporary candidate map is not that ledger. Its cause labels are not full accepted provenance records.
